name: Claude Swap
author: mrdrbrdr
description: Run several Claude Code accounts from the Omarchy bar: live 5-hour, weekly and per-model limits for each, one-click switching, and control over claude-swap's automatic rotation, with a rescue switch for when it gets stuck. Can drive several machines at once over ssh.

barWidget.description: Bar icon with the active Claude account and its fullest limit; dropdown with every account's 5-hour, weekly and model meters, switch buttons, auto-switch toggle and threshold, and account management

schema.label: Machines
schema.description: Comma-separated machines to drive together: "local" is this computer, anything else an ssh destination with key login (e.g. "server,local"). The first one is primary: its slot numbers and threshold are the ones used.

schema.label: Name for this machine
schema.description: Label shown for this computer when several machines are driven. Empty = its hostname.

schema.label: Switch automatically when everything is blocked
schema.description: When every account is past the threshold on a per-model limit, claude-swap stops switching. If the active account is then fully out of session quota and another account still has a free session window, move there anyway (at most once every 15 minutes, with a notification).
